summary_md: **Saad ([@saadkamal](https://x.com/saadkamal/status/2115006187305423085))** points to 36Kr's report that Meituan's **DeepSkill** now lists 370k agent skills verified on real tasks (up from 130k in September), with reviews from real runs and a report on whether a skill ships data off-device; he argues skills need restaurant-style ratings.
